name: Aetheris
tagline: Where gravity is a currency and the sky is a marketplace…
premise: Floating continents drift across a vast ocean of liquid nitrogen and tectonic foam, sustained by gravity-modulating crystals that pulse with natural energy.
tone: Calm, technical, grounded in scientific realism with a sense…

origin.description: Create a world where people live on floating continents above a vast ocean. Civilization is powered by crystals that manipulate gravity. There are competing trading republics, flying ships, unusual creatures, and powerful scientific institutions. I begin as a poor apprentice engineer.

intro: You wake in the cramped observation deck of a floating workshop on the western edge of the continent of Solvex, the air thick with the hum of crystal resonators. Below you, the ocean churns in a deep, shimmering blue, and the sky is dotted with drifting ships, their hulls shaped like kelp or folded metal. The crystals in the walls pulse gently, their light shifting from pale blue to amber as they absorb ambient motion.
physics: Gravity is not constant—floating continents experience tidal fluctuations in gravitational pull due to the oscillating crystals beneath them.
impossible: Travel faster than the crystal resonance frequency…
Creation of gravity wells without crystalline infrastructure…
common_knowledge: Crystals must be regularly tuned to avoid resonance collapse…
All flying ships require a gravity tether or crystal anchor…
If a crystal fails, the entire structure can drift or collapse within minutes…

magic.summary: No magic. All phenomena are governed by known physical laws, though the behavior of crystals defies classical physics and requires advanced engineering…

technology.summary: The world uses gravity-modulating crystals as a power source. Ships and structures are stabilized via embedded crystal arrays. Engineering is precise, modular, and reliant on predictive modeling of crystal resonance.
